verdict.rationale: Evidence shows GitLab surfaces security findings in merge requests and lets teams set 'rules and guardrails' for automated agents, plus audit-ready evidence collection, implying some merge-gating capability, but there is no explicit documentation of configurable approval rules, required reviewers, or protected-branch merge checks in the pack. missing for 10: explicit merge request approval rules/required approvers documentation, protected branch enforcement details, independent confirmation of customizability of these checks.
